Messages.Author: Emile Bosman
Messages.Body:
This question arose during our latest game of V:tes.

Say Beast and Sarah Gobler are in combat
Beast hits Sarah for 8
Sarah plays Burst of Sunlight at minor.

Does this cause Sarah to burn or can she choose to take the Agravated
damage first since it's from a difirent source.

Emile
"We are an ape with a symbiotic relationship to a mushroom"

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <cbf416fb.03060...@posting.google.com>,

Emile Bosman <ebo...@hotmail.com> wrote:
>This question arose during our latest game of V:tes.
>
>Say Beast and Sarah Gobler are in combat
>Beast hits Sarah for 8
>Sarah plays Burst of Sunlight at minor.
>
>Does this cause Sarah to burn or can she choose to take the Agravated
>damage first since it's from a difirent source.

Number of sources has nothing to do with it; all the damage is resolved
simultaneously, in the same strike resolution phase (unless Beast XOR Sarah
have First Strike). Regular damage is handled before aggravated (per
rulebook) so Sarah is wounded when the last point of agg is handled, and
lacking a blood to burn to prevent destruction, burns.

gomi
